title: veridict verify-run record
description: One JSONL line (or CSV row) of games.jsonl, the second argument to `veridict verify-run manifest.toml games.jsonl`. A genuinely separate schema from input-record.schema.json: verify-run computes no metric (no baseline/candidate/result numeric fields), and needs several fields input-record.schema.json has no room for. Every field is optional at the schema level; a check whose backing field never appears anywhere in the file is honestly reported as skipped (VerifyRunReport.checks_skipped), not silently passed. additionalProperties is NOT restricted here (unlike manifest.schema.json): an unknown key on a data record is harmless extra caller metadata.

id.description: Pairing key. A non-paired record (e.g. a burn-in game with no partner) simply omits it. Drives pair_completeness/role_consistency.

global_index.description: Caller-declared per-record sequence number, unique across the whole run. Drives global_index_uniqueness.

role.description: Opaque orientation tag - the domain-agnostic stand-in for 'color/side reversed within a pair' (e.g. which side moved first in a chess/shogi engine match, expressed as an opaque caller-defined value, not as 'white'/'black'). The two records sharing an id must declare two different role values. Drives role_consistency.

include_in_gate.description: null/true = this record counts toward the gated schedule order; false = a burn-in/warm-up record, excluded from schedule_order's comparison (but still subject to pair_completeness/role_consistency if it carries an id).

experiment_id.description: Compared against manifest.experiment_id by experiment_contamination to catch other-run contamination.

dataset_sha256.description: Compared against manifest.dataset_sha256 by environment_consistency for mid-run drift.

binary_sha256.description: Compared against manifest.binary_sha256 by environment_consistency for mid-run drift.

weight_sha256.description: Compared against manifest.weight_sha256 by environment_consistency for mid-run drift.

config_sha256.description: Compared against manifest.config_sha256 by environment_consistency for mid-run drift.

baseline_status.description: Same TrialStatus vocabulary as input-record.schema.json. Tallied into failure_breakdown/timeouts/crashes/invalid; 'protocol error' maps onto invalid rather than a separate domain-specific status.
